prompt_md: Ann and Ben each flip a fair coin 10 times. What's the chance they get the same number of heads?
prompt_short: Two people, 10 flips each. Same number of heads?
hint_md: Look at Ann's heads plus Ben's tails.
explain_intuition_md: There are 11 possible head counts, so 1 in 11 is tempting, but counts near 5 are far more likely than extreme ones. A neat trick: Ann's heads equal Ben's heads exactly when Ann's heads plus Ben's tails make 10. That's the same as getting exactly 10 heads in 20 flips.
